purpose: Height estimate cache for dynamically generated sidewalk positions; not known viewpoints or certified surface
lookupCRS: EPSG:6677; pyproj EPSG6697 longitude/latitude to EPSG6677 easting/northing, floor(value/2) mesh lookup

source.attribution: 東京都デジタルサービス局 高密度点群データを加工（2mメッシュ化・class2地面高さ中央値抽出）
source.processing: pyproj transformed lookup of class2 ground p50; source points and roadway selection modified; no guaranteed upper bound or standing-height certification

limits: Class2 ground may lie below bridge deck.
All-return quantiles are observed heights, not guaranteed obstruction bounds.
Missing ground is null, never replaced by roof/return maximum or zero.
Coordinates are generated by application; this file is a height cache, not recommended locations.
